subject: general
question: Which of the following is the largest mangrove forest in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sundarbans Reserve Forest.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• World’s largest deltaic mangrove forests are found in Sundarbans Reserve Forest.__
 
• The Sundarbans Reserve Forest is located in **both India and Bangladesh**, and is part of the Ganges Delta.
 
• It lies on the delta of Meghna, Brahmaputra, and Ganges rivers.
 
• It is known for its wide range of fauna, comprising 260 bird species.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Mangrove, any of certain shrubs and trees that grow in dense bushes or forests along tidal estuaries, in salt marshes, and on muddy coasts.
 
• Mangroves serve as a** buffer between marine and terrestrial ecosystems **and protect shorelines from damaging winds, waves, and floods.
 
• India has a total mangrove cover of 4,975 sq km.
 
• It is 0.15% of the country’s total geographical area.
 
• West Bengal has 42.45% of India’s mangrove cover.
 
• West Bengal is followed by Gujarat at 23.66% and Andaman & Nicobar Islands at 12.39%. 
 
• Sundarban Mangroves are found in West Bengal.
